For a 50-person Indian company, these three are worth shortlisting:

Option	What differentiates it
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Best suited to SMEs wanting a quick rollout. Corporate fares, GST invoices, travel-policy controls, expense management, central wallet and 24/7 assistance. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1

EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	More travel-manager oriented: centralised employee bookings, policy controls, expense reporting, negotiated fares and 24/7 support. It says it serves 4,000+ businesses. 
EaseMyTrip

Thomas Cook India – Corporate Travel	More traditional managed-TMC model, combining travel experts with technology, self-booking, approval workflows, booking bots and backend reconciliation/accounting integration. 
Thomas Cook

Practical distinction: myBiz/EMTDesk are more self-serve platforms; Thomas Cook is more suitable if you want human travel-management support alongside the software.

Pricing: these providers generally quote corporate pricing rather than publishing a fixed ₹/employee fee, so request a 50-employee proposal with transaction fees, GST treatment, cancellation/change charges and 24/7 support SLA before comparing total cost.
